title: Marvel Comics Red Venom Carnage Molded Head Ceramic Coffee Tea Mug 16 OZ 2015
descriptionText: This Marvel Comics Red Venom Carnage Molded Head Ceramic Coffee Tea Mug from 2015 features a 16 oz capacity. Spider-Man. The mug depicts the character Venom from the Marvel franchise, showcasing a vibrant red color. It is a collectible item that would be a perfect addition to any Marvel fan's kitchen or home decor.
